CH3 S N ONa O Cl 3 H2O Cl O H N H N Cl Cl Cl Cl O OH Cl HN N N Cl O O Cl O 1666 Disinfectants and Preservatives Profile Troclosene sodium is a disinfectant with the general properties of chlorine (p.1638) and sodium hypochlorite (above) but it re- mains active as pH increases from 6 to 10 and is reported to be less susceptible to inactivation by organic material. It contains about 56 to 65% of ‘available chlorine’ (see p.1638). Troclosene sodium is used for disinfecting hard surfaces (see Disinfection in Hepatitis and HIV Infection, p.1623), babies’ feeding bottles, and food and dairy equipment, for treating water (p.1623), for rapid disinfection of swimming pools, for soft con- tact lens care (p.1622), and in various commercial bleach deter- gents and scouring powders as a relatively stable source of chlo- rine.
